units.source_text: 紫花地丁每到春天就开花，一般开三朵，最多五朵。

en.t: The violet blooms every spring, usually with three flowers and at most five.

units.source_text: 尽管如此，每年春天它都要在树上这个小洞里抽芽开花。

en.t: Even so, every spring it sends out shoots and blossoms in this small hollow in the tree.

units.source_text: 千重子时而在廊道上眺望，时而在树根旁仰视，不时被树上那株紫花地丁的生命打动，或者勾起孤单的伤感情绪。

en.t: Sometimes Chieko gazed at it from the veranda, and sometimes she looked up at it from beside the tree roots; now and then she was moved by the life of that violet in the tree, or was stirred into a lonely sadness.
